cases.question: 列出 2026-10-15 至 2026-10-21 每天发生且获批的退款金额。

metric.name: 按退款事件日统计的批准退款金额
metric.formula: 退款事件日的批准退款金额之和
metric.numerator_definition: 退款事件日的批准退款金额之和
metric.denominator_definition: 不适用；该指标为金额或计数聚合
metric.freshness: 固定数据契约；无生产 freshness SLA 或实时性保证

result.sql:
SELECT substr(r.refunded_at, 1, 10) AS group_value, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount_cents
FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.status = 'approved' AND r.refunded_at >= ? AND r.refunded_at < ? AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY group_value
ORDER BY group_value
LIMIT 100
limitations: 只回答语义目录支持的单指标和维度。
当前数据为可复现的合成样本。

cases.question: 按退款状态分组，汇总 2026-10-15 至 2026-10-21 的退款记录金额。

metric.name: 各处理状态退款金额
metric.formula: 按退款状态汇总退款记录金额；批准指标只计 approved
metric.numerator_definition: 按退款状态汇总退款记录金额；批准指标只计 approved
metric.denominator_definition: 不适用；该指标为金额或计数聚合
metric.freshness: 固定数据契约；无生产 freshness SLA 或实时性保证

result.sql:
SELECT r.status AS group_value, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount_cents
FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.refunded_at >= ? AND r.refunded_at < ? AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY r.status
ORDER BY r.status
LIMIT 100
limitations: 只回答语义目录支持的单指标和维度。
